stem: Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.
solution: In every next figure, each symbol shifts to the next position up along the same diagonal, and the symbol at the top moves to the bottom.

stem: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 have been written on the surfaces of a dice. Four forms of the dice are shown below. In this dice which digit will be on the surface opposite to the digit 3?
solution: From (ii) and (iii): 1 is opposite 4, 2 is opposite 5, so 3 is opposite 6.

stem: If it is possible to form a word with the first, fourth, seventh and eleventh letters in the word 'SUPERFLUOUS', write the first letter of that word.
solution: Letters S, E, L, S form LESS; the first letter is L.
